-- Retrouver la source demandée parmi les sources connues (articles) ou déjà bloquées par l'utilisateur
SELECT
  (SELECT s FROM (
     SELECT DISTINCT source AS s FROM articles WHERE source IS NOT NULL
     UNION
     SELECT source FROM blocked_sources WHERE user_id = $1::int
   ) known
   WHERE length(trim($2::text)) >= 3
     AND (lower(s) = lower(trim($2::text)) OR position(lower(trim($2::text)) IN lower(s)) > 0)
   ORDER BY (lower(s) = lower(trim($2::text))) DESC, length(s)
   LIMIT 1) AS matched,
  COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT source ORDER BY source) FROM articles WHERE source IS NOT NULL), '{}') AS known_sources,
  COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(source ORDER BY source) FROM blocked_sources WHERE user_id = $1::int), '{}') AS blocked;

-- Bloquer ou débloquer, uniquement si la validation est OK ($4) ; 20 sources bloquées max
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO blocked_sources (user_id, source)
  SELECT $1::int, $3::text
  WHERE $2::text = 'block' AND $4::boolean
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM blocked_sources WHERE user_id = $1::int) < 20
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING source
), del AS (
  DELETE FROM blocked_sources
  WHERE user_id = $1::int AND source = $3::text AND $2::text = 'unblock' AND $4::boolean
  RETURNING source
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)::int AS inserted, (SELECT count(*) FROM del)::int AS deleted;
